description: This file defines the Parser class for the JMESPath library, implementing a Pratt parser to parse JMESPath expressions into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). It contains methods for parsing various parts of the language, such as literals, identifiers, projections, filters, and function calls.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A Pratt parser class for parsing JMESPath expressions into an AST.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a JMESPath expression into an AST, throws syntax error if parsing fails.

methods.name: expr
methods.description: Parses an expression with a given right binding power, implementing operator precedence parsing.

methods.name: nud_identifier
methods.description: Handles parsing of identifier tokens, converting them into field nodes.

methods.name: nud_quoted_identifier
methods.description: Handles parsing of quoted identifiers.

methods.name: nud_current
methods.description: Handles parsing of the current node token.

methods.name: nud_literal
methods.description: Handles parsing of literal tokens.

methods.name: nud_expref
methods.description: Handles parsing of expression reference tokens.

methods.name: nud_not
methods.description: Handles parsing of the NOT operator.

methods.name: nud_lparen
methods.description: Handles parsing of parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: nud_lbrace
methods.description: Handles parsing of object literals.

methods.name: nud_flatten
methods.description: Handles parsing of flatten projection.

methods.name: nud_filter
methods.description: Handles parsing of filter projections.

methods.name: nud_star
methods.description: Handles parsing of wildcard projections.

methods.name: nud_lbracket
methods.description: Handles parsing of bracket expressions like arrays and slices.

methods.name: led_lbracket
methods.description: Handles parsing of array index and slicing expressions.

methods.name: led_flatten
methods.description: Handles parsing when a flatten operator is involved.

methods.name: led_dot
methods.description: Handles parsing of dot notation for object property access.

methods.name: led_or
methods.description: Handles parsing of logical OR operations.

methods.name: led_and
methods.description: Handles parsing of logical AND operations.

methods.name: led_pipe
methods.description: Handles parsing of pipe operators.

methods.name: led_lparen
methods.description: Handles parsing of function call argument lists.

methods.name: led_filter
methods.description: Handles parsing of filter expressions within brackets.

methods.name: led_comparator
methods.description: Handles parsing of comparison operators.

methods.name: parseProjection
methods.description: Parses projections, which include dotted paths, wildcards, and filters.

methods.name: parseDot
methods.description: Parses dot notation segments.

methods.name: parseKeyValuePair
methods.description: Parses key-value pairs inside object literals.

methods.name: parseWildcardObject
methods.description: Parses wildcard projections on objects.

methods.name: parseWildcardArray
methods.description: Parses wildcard projections on arrays.

methods.name: parseArrayIndexExpression
methods.description: Parses array index or slice expressions, e.g., [0], [1:2].

methods.name: parseMultiSelectList
methods.description: Parses multi-select list expressions inside brackets.

methods.name: syntax
methods.description: Creates a syntax error exception with a message.

methods.name: lookahead
methods.description: Returns the next token type without advancing the token stream.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next token, optionally matching specific token types.

methods.name: assertNotToken
methods.description: Ensures the current token is not of a specific type, throws error if it is.
